summary: Committed the Gizmo registry's WIP (CSS extraction, unity tooling, new extensions, design refresh, plus the assistant's git-panel overlay fix) as a single commit after `pnpm check` (tsc --noEmit) passed cleanly. Reported the final state across both repos: two Gizmo commits (transport refactor, narrow-width CSS fixes with builder port) and the registry commit, with screenshots cleaned up and the rebuilt git.web.js reproducible from the now-committed git.css.
decisions: Ran `pnpm check` (tsc --noEmit) in the registry before committing as a cheap sanity check; chose to still commit per user's explicit instruction even if it had failed.

Wrote the registry commit message from a diff overview, grouping themes (extension CSS extraction, unity package, new extensions, design refresh) rather than enumerating files; flagged that the user should amend if the message misrepresents the WIP's intent.
